technology_name: A DEVICE WITH AI INTERFACE FOR PREDICTING DOSAGE OF VITAMIN K ANTAGONISTS FOR MANAGING ORAL ANTICOAGULANT DRUGS
institution: National Institute of Technology Calicut (NIT Calicut)
technology_type: Medical Diagnostic Tool / AI Predictive Dosage Hardware
problem_solved: Prescribing precision doses of oral Vitamin K anticoagulant therapies manually faces unstable metabolic variations that spike dangerous internal internal hemorrhaging risks.
description: A diagnostic device comprising a patient demographic input dashboard, a localized microprocessor module, an offline database tracking unit, and a calculated Support Vector Machine (SVM) regression calculation engine to display targeted dosage volumes.
applications: Point-of-care clinical tracking, cardiology medication monitoring blocks, automated pharmacy prescription desks, and decentralized healthcare diagnostic assets.
secondary_sector: MedTech & Health Care, Biotechnology & Life Sciences
